questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer:
Not so easy to find affordable decent housing with student from Adelaide, but patience is key and using
Flatmates.au
is recommended

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Living off campus is nice if you find a good house, but can be a bit lonely as Adelaide is quite quiet and can be difficult to interact with locals from Adelaide. Student housing is, however, very expensive and small, but social.
